title: InterMT: Multi-Turn Interleaved Preference Alignment with Human Feedback
authors_zh: Boyuan Chen、Donghai Hong、Jiaming Ji、Jiacheng Zheng、Bowen Dong、Jiayi Zhou、Kaile Wang、Juntao Dai、Xuyao Wang、Wenqi Chen、Qirui Zheng、Wenxin Li、Sirui Han、Yike Guo、Yaodong Yang
best_for_zh: 偏好学习、奖励建模与反馈审计研究者
one_line: InterMT releases human preference annotations for competing multi-turn, interleaved image-text conversations, covering both local turns and complete interaction trajectories.
InterMT 发布竞争性多轮图文交错对话的人工偏好标注，同时覆盖局部回合与完整交互轨迹。
why: Human preferences over multi-turn interleaved multimodal conversations with local and global feedback.
inclusion_reason: Human preferences over multi-turn interleaved multimodal conversations with local and global feedback.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Single-turn preference data cannot represent whether a multimodal assistant remains helpful as images and instructions change across a conversation. InterMT targets the local turn-level and global conversation-level judgments needed for multi-turn interleaved image–text interaction.

It constructs a human-preference dataset and benchmark for these long-horizon conversations, rather than treating one isolated answer as the full alignment target.

单轮偏好数据无法表示多模态助手在图像和指令随对话变化时能否持续有帮助。InterMT 处理多轮交错图文交互所需的局部回合判断和全局会话判断。

它构造面向长程对话的人类偏好数据集和基准，而不把单个孤立回答视为完整对齐目标。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: InterMT combines 15,604 seed questions, 52.6K multi-turn interleaved vision-language instances, and 32,459 multi-dimensional human preference annotations. The contract separates four local and five global helpfulness dimensions, with critiques, suggestions, and rationales; it therefore preserves both a turn decision and a trajectory decision.
InterMT 包含 15,604 个种子问题、52.6K 条多轮交错视觉语言实例和 32,459 组多维人类偏好标注。其契约区分四项局部和五项全局有帮助维度，并保留批评、建议和理由，因此同时保存回合决策与轨迹决策。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Harvest and refine seed questions from open datasets, web data, and human writing for multi-turn potential. 2. Use MLLMs plus editing, generation, and retrieval tools to expand each seed into candidate conversation trees. 3. Filter and prune candidates, retaining 52.6K QA instances. 4. Collect local score/pair judgments and global conversation judgments across nine helpfulness dimensions; low-consistency annotations are re-annotated and sampled records are audited.

The release is CC BY-NC 4.0. Reproduction needs seed sources, agent/tool versions, pruning rules, annotation rubric, and the seed-disjoint 9:1 split.

1. 从开放数据、网页和人工写作中采集并精炼具有多轮潜力的种子问题。2. 用 MLLM 及编辑、生成、检索工具把每个种子扩展为候选会话树。3. 过滤并剪枝候选，保留 52.6K 条问答实例。4. 按九项有帮助维度收集局部评分／成对判断和全局会话判断；一致性低的标注重新标注，并抽样审计。

发布采用 CC BY-NC 4.0。复现需固定种子来源、代理／工具版本、剪枝规则、标注量表和种子不重叠的 9:1 划分。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Claim: present MLLM judges do not reliably recover human judgments over multi-turn multimodal interaction. On InterMT-Bench, the paper evaluates scoring, pair comparison, and crucial-step recognition; reported score-evaluation Pearson correlations are low across the listed models, while the paper reports near-human 4.38/5 performance for crucial-step recognition. This supports the need for human-annotated local/global supervision, not a claim that every MLLM judgment is unreliable.
主张：现有多模态语言模型裁判无法可靠复现多轮多模态交互中的人类判断。论文在 InterMT-Bench 上评估评分、成对比较和关键步骤识别；列出的评分评估 Pearson 相关性普遍较低，而关键步骤识别报告接近人类的 4.38/5。这支持需要带局部／全局监督的人类标注，而不表示所有多模态语言模型判断都不可靠。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest multimodal preference datasets focus on a single image–text response. InterMT changes the feedback object to competing interleaved conversation trajectories, and separates local from global helpfulness in nine dimensions. Agent-based construction is not itself the novelty; the changed supervision granularity is.
最接近的多模态偏好数据集聚焦单个图文回答。InterMT 将反馈对象改为竞争的交错会话轨迹，并按九个维度区分局部与全局有帮助。基于代理的构造本身不是新意；改变的是监督粒度。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Author-stated limitation: InterMT covers vision and language, while human communication also uses video and audio; applying its labels to those modalities is unsupported. Curator risk: agent-generated trajectories and NSFW filtering may not represent real conversations; audit tool traces and sensitive-content failures before reuse.
作者所述局限：InterMT 覆盖视觉和语言，而人类交流还包括视频和音频，将其标签用于这些模态没有依据。策展风险：代理生成轨迹和不安全内容过滤未必代表真实对话；复用前应审计工具轨迹和敏感内容失效。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use InterMT to train or evaluate a reward/judge model that receives a conversation prefix, interleaved visual context, and competing next turns or full trajectories. Preserve local/global labels and seed-disjoint splits; success is agreement on each level, not only one aggregate score. Do not use it as evidence for audio/video interaction alignment.
可用 InterMT 训练或评估接收会话前缀、交错视觉上下文和竞争下一回合或完整轨迹的奖励／裁判模型。应保留局部／全局标签及种子不重叠划分；成功标准是两个层级的判断一致，而不只是一个汇总分数。它不适合作为音频／视频交互对齐的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. InterMT evaluates evolving preference across conversations, not isolated VQA.
  2. Agent tools create candidate trees; human dual verification determines retained labels.
  3. It releases 15,604 seeds, 52.6K instances, and 32,459 annotations.
  4. Judge correlations are low on scoring; crucial-step recognition reaches 4.38/5.
  5. Reuse local/global labels separately and audit agent traces.

1. InterMT 评估随会话变化的偏好，而非孤立视觉问答。
  2. 代理工具生成候选树，人工双重核验决定保留标签。
  3. 数据含 15,604 个种子、52.6K 条实例和 32,459 组标注。
  4. 裁判在评分任务的相关性低，关键步骤识别为 4.38/5。
  5. 应分开复用局部／全局标签，并审计代理轨迹。
